# `surrogate_lagfree_spatial_events`

one draw of the lag-free surrogate of the spatial events (the same graph on a lag-free surrogate of the recording), its home map and patch summary as statistics.

Version 2, scope `subject`. Run it with `nxr-neuro run surrogate_lagfree_spatial_events --dataset <folder> --subject <id> ...`; `nxr-neuro run surrogate_lagfree_spatial_events --help` prints the same options.

Examples:

```
nxr-neuro run surrogate_lagfree_spatial_events --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --recording rest --cross-spectrum rest_crossspectrum_alpha --seed 1 --all
```

## Inputs

| input | what it is | required |
|---|---|---|
| `recording` | field recording, each true, where {"name": "$recording"}, read shape | yes |
| `kernel` | operator inverse kernel, from recording.manifold.0, where {"name": "$kernel", "params.inverse.measure": "$method"} | yes |
| `tiles` | selection ladder, manifold kernel.to (the surface's grid (`nxr-neuro run select_dyadic_surface` first)) | yes |
| `glued` | manifold surface, where {"name": "$glued_surface"} (the glued cortex (`nxr-neuro run glue` first)) | yes |
| `grid` | selection any, manifold recording.time, where {"name": "{recording} time grid frames ${band} ${frames_per_cycle} per cycle"} (the band's frame grid (`nxr-neuro run select_time_grid --rule frames --band 8-12Hz` first)) | yes |
| `bursts` | selection spans, manifold recording.time, where {"name": "$bursts"} | yes |
| `baseline` | statistic mean, where {"name": "$baseline_statistic"} | yes |
| `threshold` | statistic histogram, where {"name": "$threshold_statistic"}, required false | no |
| `bad` | selection spans, manifold recording.time, where {"name": "{recording}_bad_segments"}, required false | no |
| `psd` | statistic welch, where {"name": "$psd_statistic"} | yes |
| `cross_spectrum` | statistic welch, where {"name": "$cross_spectrum"} | yes |
| `power_series` | measurement power, of recording, where {"name": "$power_series_over"} (the data's band power per tile: `nxr-neuro run measure --set surrogate_lagfree_envelope` first) | yes |
| `psd_channel_mean` | measurement mean, of psd, where {"name": "$psd_channel_mean_over"} (the PSD's mean over channels, a stored measurement (`nxr-neuro run measure --set psd_channel_mean` first), read by name) | yes |

## Parameters

Each is an option `--<name> VALUE` (dashes for underscores; the value is read as YAML) or `--set NAME=VALUE`.

| parameter | option | default | unit | choices | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `recording` | `--recording` | `none` | - |  | the recording's name, or none: every recording of the subject, one run each |
| `seed` | `--seed` | `0` | - |  | the draw (a whole number >= 0): its own node, its own cache key |
| `taps_half` | `--taps-half` | `0` | samples |  | the surrogate's taps: 0 from the PSD's resolution |
| `psd_statistic` | `--psd-statistic` | `{recording}_psd_welch` | - |  | the stored PSD statistic, by name |
| `cross_spectrum` | `--cross-spectrum` | `none` | - |  | the band's stored cross-spectrum (`run crossspectrum --channels-of KERNEL`), by name |
| `power_series_over` | `--power-series-over` | none | - |  | the selection the band power per tile (preset surrogate_lagfree_envelope) was measured over, by name; null: the one that holds it |
| `psd_channel_mean_over` | `--psd-channel-mean-over` | none | - |  | the selection the PSD's channel mean (preset psd_channel_mean) was measured over, by name; null: the one that holds it |
| `kernel` | `--kernel` | `none` | - |  | the inverse kernel's name, or none: found by `method` (the named kernel must also be of that method: --method) |
| `band` | `--band` | `8-12 Hz` | Hz |  | the temporal band as a quantity (the frames and the time grid are resolved from it) |
| `shape` | `--shape` | `morlet` | - |  | the temporal band's shape: morlet \| meyer |
| `spatial_shape` | `--spatial-shape` | `mexhat` | - |  | the spatial level's gain: mexhat \| meyer |
| `spatial_scales` | `--spatial-scales` | `["parts 4", "parts 8", "parts 16", "parts 32", "parts 64", "parts 128", "parts 256"]` | mm |  | the scale space: one hat each, as quantities; must be the baseline's |
| `reference_scale` | `--reference-scale` | `parts 64` | mm |  | the scale whose relative power the patches are cut from |
| `method` | `--method` | `MNE` | - |  | the kernel's inverse method (its params.inverse.measure) |
| `transform` | `--transform` | `auto` | - |  | the spatial band's transform: auto \| eigen \| chebyshev \| exact |
| `modes` | `--modes` | `0` | modes |  | when the eigenmodes are computed: the package's size; 0: the standard 3000, or more when the level needs it |
| `order` | `--order` | `0` | degree |  | chebyshev degree; 0: the smallest of 40 to 5120 within `tolerance` of the band's gain |
| `tolerance` | `--tolerance` | `0.01` | fraction |  | the largest difference between the band's gain and the chebyshev series that is accepted |
| `frames_per_cycle` | `--frames-per-cycle` | `36` | frames/cycle |  | the frame density: frames to one cycle of the band's centre (the 10 degree step of phase work); the data's, as the draw is of the data's chain |
| `frames_per_tile` | `--frames-per-tile` | none | frames/tile |  | the frame density per tile of the band instead (a power of two); wins over frames_per_cycle when given |
| `origin` | `--origin` | `start` | - | start, clock, event | the frames' origin as a point: start \| clock \| event |
| `glued_surface` | `--glued-surface` | none | - |  | the glued cortex made by `run glue`, by name |
| `bursts` | `--bursts` | `global_bursts.bursts_kept.{recording}` | - |  | the spans Selection the run uses, by name |
| `baseline_statistic` | `--baseline-statistic` | `spatial_baseline.baseline.{recording}` | - |  | the stored baseline (`run spatial_baseline`), by name |
| `threshold_statistic` | `--threshold-statistic` | `spatial_threshold.histogram.{recording}` | - |  | the stored distribution of the relative power outside the bursts (`run spatial_threshold`), by name |
| `threshold` | `--threshold` | `percentile` | - |  | percentile (the default: the false-alarm rate, measured) \| ratio (a multiple of the vertex's baseline) |
| `percentile` | `--percentile` | `99.0` | percentile |  | threshold percentile: the relative power's 99th percentile outside the bursts (about 1 % of vertices above it on frames with no event) |
| `ratio` | `--ratio` | `2.0` | ratio |  | threshold ratio: the patches are where the relative power is at least this multiple of the vertex's baseline (about 13.5 % of vertices on noise alone) |
| `min_area` | `--min-area` | `0.0` | m2 |  | m²: smaller patches are dropped |
| `bad_segments` | `--bad-segments` | `exclude` | - |  | exclude \| ignore the recording's bad spans |
| `block_frames` | `--block-frames` | `256` | frames |  | the frames cut at once by the finder (memory only: the result does not depend on it) |

## The chain of nodes

| phase | node | in | with | out |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| before | [`synthesis.lagfree_mixing`](../nodes.md) | cross_spectrum=cross_spectrum |  | mixing |
| chunks over `recording` | [`synthesis.lagfree`](../nodes.md) | x=recording, psd=psd, psd_channel_mean=psd_channel_mean, cross_spectrum=cross_spectrum, power_series=power_series | band=$band, shape=$shape, taps_half=$taps_half, seed=$seed | y |
| chunks over `recording` | [`signal.analytic_frames`](../nodes.md) | x=y, tiling=grid, within=bursts | band=$band, shape=$shape, frames_per_cycle=$frames_per_cycle, frames_per_tile=$frames_per_tile, origin=$origin | z_frames |
| chunks over `recording` | [`meeg.apply_kernel`](../nodes.md) | x=z_frames, kernel=kernel, tiles=tiles, glued=glued, pre_operator=mixing | spatial_scales=$spatial_scales, transform=$transform, modes=$modes, order=$order, tolerance=$tolerance, spatial_shape=$spatial_shape | j |
| chunks over `recording` | [`signal.field_form`](../nodes.md) | x=j | form=power | p |
| chunks over `recording` | [`measurement.relative`](../nodes.md) | x=p, baseline=baseline |  | r |
| chunks over `recording` | [`select.at_level`](../nodes.md) | x=r | scale=$reference_scale | r_ref |
| chunks over `recording` | [`select.scale`](../nodes.md) | x=p | transform=$transform, modes=$modes, order=$order, tolerance=$tolerance | sc |
| chunks over `recording` | [`select.events.patches`](../nodes.md) | x=r_ref, scale=sc, bursts=bursts, exclude=bad, threshold=threshold | threshold=$threshold, percentile=$percentile, ratio=$ratio, min_area=$min_area, block_frames=$block_frames, bad_segments=$bad_segments, events=false | events, frame, burst, centre_vertex, centre, area, diameter_cm, characteristic_level, size_cm, relative_peak, home, summary |

`before` steps run once, `chunks` steps run on every chunk of the recording, `after` steps run once on what the chunks accumulated.

## Outputs

| output | stored as |
|---|---|
| `home` | kind statistic |
| `summary` | kind statistic |

## Notes from the definition

```text
ONE DRAW OF THE LAG-FREE SURROGATE of the spatial events (spec docs/specs/2026-11-17-surrogates.md; docs/specs/2026-11-14-spatial-events.md, "Statistics and nulls"): the SAME graph as
`run spatial_events`, run on a lag-free surrogate of the recording in place of the recording (Gaussian noise with the data's own spectrum, scaled to the data's band envelope: `run measure --set surrogate_lagfree_envelope`,
mixed by the band's real cross-spectrum as its zero-lag covariance, no lag). The baseline, the threshold and the burst frames are the DATA's: only the signal is replaced, so the draw's patches are what
the same threshold finds in a signal with the data's covariance, spectrum and envelope and no travelling.
THE ORDER (spec section 4): white -> shaping taps -> envelope scale (`synthesis.lagfree`, UNMIXED) -> analytic -> frames -> ONE fused operator per hat level (the kernel's current through the level's hat on
the glued surface, composed with the zero-lag mixing: apply_kernel's `pre_operator`), built once and cached across the draws. The first non-linear step is `power`.
A DRAW NEVER READS THE RECORDING (`read: shape`). A draw is the run with `seed: i` (`draw: seed`); only the HOME MAP and the PATCH SUMMARY are stored (small statistics:
`surrogate_lagfree_spatial_events.draw<seed>.home.<recording>`, `.summary.<recording>`), never the surrogate or the patches. `run surrogate_lagfree_spatial_events_compare` runs the draws in batches with
early stopping and compares the data's home map and patch sizes with them.

  nxr-neuro run surrogate_lagfree_spatial_events --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --recording rest --cross-spectrum rest_crossspectrum_alpha --seed 1 --all
```
